title: Goal Tree Schema
description: Hierarchical structure for goal decomposition where top-level goals are recursively decomposed into subgoals such that the conjunction of subgoals entails the parent goal. Each level describes desired emergent properties of RE (requirements specification). Lower-level goals are means to achieve higher-level goals and are more operationalized.

goal-tree.description: Root container for all goals in the tree

goal.description: A goal node in the hierarchical tree. Can contain nested subgoals recursively. Lower-level goals are means to achieve higher-level goals and are more operationalized.

goal-id.description: Unique identifier for this goal node

goal-name.description: Name or title of the goal

goal-description.description: Description of the desired emergent property of RE (requirements specification) that this goal represents

goal-rationale.description: Explanation of why this goal exists and how it contributes to achieving the parent goal

sub-goals.description: Array of subgoals that jointly entail this goal. Lower-level goals are means to achieve higher-level goals. Can contain nested goal objects recursively.

sud-involvement.description: Whether the System under Development (SuD) plays a part in achieving this goal. Goals with SuD involvement should be displayed in italics.

operationalization-level.description: Level of operationalization of this goal relative to its position in the hierarchy

means-end-relationship.description: Description of how this goal serves as a means to achieve its parent goal (for subgoals) or how it represents an end state (for top-level goals)

emergent-properties.description: Desired emergent properties of RE (requirements specification) that this goal contributes to

requirements-references.description: Array of requirement IDs (from set R) that this goal addresses

domain-knowledge-references.description: Array of domain knowledge IDs (from set K) relevant to this goal

validation-status.description: Track validation state for goal decomposition

conjunction-logic-verified.description: Whether subgoals jointly entail parent goal

means-end-verified.description: Whether lower-level goals are verified as means to achieve higher-level goals

operationalization-verified.description: Whether lower levels are more operationalized than higher levels

emergent-properties-validated.description: Whether emergent properties of RE are properly described

atomic-goal.description: Whether this goal is atomic (no further decomposition needed)
